support: all unique fixed TSDF vertices visible in this frame and inside the complete mask
exact_duplicate_key: frame + identical full-image binary mask; retain every original occurrence
grouping: descending TSDF support count; compare remaining masks only to the fixed primary seed; no transitive expansion
source_policy: window/cabinet SAM-only; any prior semantic CropFormer replacement is global across all ROI occurrences
policy_order: source eligibility first, then ordinary 3D IoU grouping, then maximum TSDF support count
primary_seed: largest unique TSDF support count among source-eligible masks
tie_break: ascending frame, model index, full-mask digest; no area ranking
